tasks.spec: You are a one-task Ringer probe worker performing a read-only API smoke test against the JobTread Pave API. Boundary: this is a smoke test, not a code-editing task. Never modify any file except your two deliverables. NEVER write, echo, or log the grant key value anywhere — refer to it only via the environment variable name. You own exactly two files: /Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r0-pave-auth/r0-probe-output.json and /Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r0-pave-auth/r0-probe-transcript.md. GOAL: prove the grant key JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY (stored in /Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env) authenticates against JobTread Pave and can see organization id 22PazeRM5FCH (Pro Exteriors). HOW TO RUN — execute exactly this sequence: (1) set -a; source /Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env; set +a. (2) Build a JSON request body FILE (use a heredoc with envsubst or python) with this shape: {"query": {"$": {"grantKey": "<value of $JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY>"}, "currentGrant": {"id": {}, "user": {"id": {}, "name": {}, "memberships": {"nodes": {"id": {}, "organization": {"id": {}, "name": {}}}}}}}. Write this body file to /tmp/r0-pave-body.json (NOT to the out/ directory) so the key never lands in a deliverable. (3) POST it: curl -s -X POST https://api.jobtread.com/pave -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data @/tmp/r0-pave-body.json. (4) Pipe the response through python3 -m json.tool and save it as r0-probe-output.json. If the response contains the grant key anywhere (it should not), replace the key value with the string REDACTED before saving. (5) rm /tmp/r0-pave-body.json. (6) Write r0-probe-transcript.md with sections: ## Probe Goal, ## Commands Run (with the grantKey value shown as $JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY, never expanded), ## Observed Behavior (HTTP status, response shape), ## Model Response Or API Result (summary: user name, org ids and names seen), ## Verdict (pass only if org 22PazeRM5FCH appeared in the actual response; otherwise fail with the exact error body excerpt). Hard rules: do not write pass unless the org id actually appeared in the live response; if the API returns an auth error, record the full error body excerpt in the transcript and mark the verdict fail — a failed probe honestly reported is a successful task.
